# `landed-cost` commands

## `landed-cost charges`

Unallocated landed-cost charges by vendor, document, date and amount: every Landed Cost Clearing line of a bill, check, card charge or vendor credit (a freight credit is negative) less what allocations took. Ties the total to the clearing account on every date and refuses when they differ. Example: `bookflow landed-cost charges`.

| Contract | Value |
|---|---|
| Scope | company |
| Kind | read |
| Required role | member |
| Capability | ledger.read |
| Feature | — |
| HTTP | `POST /companies/{company_id}/commands/landed-cost.charges` |
| External binary body | none |

### CLI

`bookflow landed-cost charges --company "Demo Plumbing Co" --json`

### MCP

The same example as complete `bookflow_run` arguments:

```json
{"command": "landed-cost charges", "input": {}, "company": "Company ID or name"}
```

## `landed-cost post`

Spread freight, duty or another landed cost over the stock it came with. Charges are Landed Cost Clearing lines on bills, checks, card charges and vendor credits (`landed-cost charges` lists what is unallocated); targets are item receipts and the item lines of bills, checks and card charges that brought the stock in, whole or by line or item. basis: quantity (default), value, weight, volume or amounts. Each target receipt's share joins its cost as if it had been on the receipt, but is recognised at the allocation date: stock already sold before then owes a forward true-up to cost of goods sold dated at the allocation, stock still on hand keeps it. The date defaults to the latest charge date, never before a target receipt, moved to the first open date when the period is closed, so a freight bill for stock received before the close posts wholly in the open period. A charge may be allocated in parts; a freight credit allocates negative amounts. The dry run shows each target's share split into stock and issued. Example: `bookflow landed-cost post --charges '[{"document":"FRT-88"}]' --targets '[{"document":"IR-1001"},{"document":"IR-1002"}]' --basis quantity --reason "Freight for last week's deliveries"`.

A dry run previews the proposed result without saving it. Any proposed record IDs or posted status in that preview describe the prospective save, not an existing saved record.

| Contract | Value |
|---|---|
| Scope | company |
| Kind | write |
| Required role | standard |
| Capability | ledger.post |
| Feature | — |
| HTTP | `POST /companies/{company_id}/commands/landed-cost.post` |
| External binary body | none |

### CLI

`bookflow landed-cost post --charges '[{"document":"DEMO-FREIGHT-1"}]' --targets '[{"document":"DEMO-PIPE-1"},{"document":"DEMO-PIPE-2"}]' --basis quantity --company "Demo Plumbing Co" --reason "Freight for last week's pipe" --dry-run --json`

```json
{"command": "landed-cost post", "input": {"charges": [{"document": "DEMO-FREIGHT-1"}], "targets": [{"document": "DEMO-PIPE-1"}, {"document": "DEMO-PIPE-2"}], "basis": "quantity"}, "company": "Company ID or name", "dry_run": true, "reason": "Preview the requested change"}
```

### Input

| JSON field | CLI input | Type | Required | Nullable | Default | Description and constraints |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `charges[].charge` | inside `--charges` JSON array | string \| null | no | yes | null | A charge line, by the `charge` id `landed-cost charges` lists. Give this or document. |
| `charges[].document` | inside `--charges` JSON array | string \| null | no | yes | null | The bill, check, card charge or vendor credit holding the charge, by id or number: every unallocated Landed Cost Clearing line on it. |
| `charges[].amount` | inside `--charges` JSON array | string \| null | no | yes | null | How much of the charge to allocate now, at most what is unallocated; omitted, all of it. A freight credit (a vendor credit line) is negative; give its amount as a positive number or leave it out. |
| `targets[].document` | inside `--targets` JSON array | string \| null | no | yes | null | An item receipt, or a bill, check or card charge whose item lines brought the stock in, by id or number: each of its stock lines, or the one line or item named below. |
| `targets[].movement` | inside `--targets` JSON array | string \| null | no | yes | null | One receipt movement by id (as `landed-cost show` lists). |
| `targets[].line` | inside `--targets` JSON array | integer \| null | no | yes | null | Only this stock line of the document (1 is its first stock line). |
| `targets[].item` | inside `--targets` JSON array | string \| null | no | yes | null | Only the document's lines of this item (name, id or barcode). |
| `targets[].account` | inside `--targets` JSON array | string \| null | no | yes | null | An expense or cost-of-goods account instead of a receipt, for a share that should not be capitalised; basis amounts only. |
| `targets[].amount` | inside `--targets` JSON array | string \| null | no | yes | null | This target's share, with basis amounts; the shares sum exactly to the charges. |
| `targets[].unit_weight` | inside `--targets` JSON array | string \| null | no | yes | null | With basis weight: the weight of one base unit, instead of the item's. |
| `targets[].unit_volume` | inside `--targets` JSON array | string \| null | no | yes | null | With basis volume: the volume of one base unit, instead of the item's. |
| `basis` | `--basis` | literal["quantity", "value", "weight", "volume", "amounts"] | no | no | "quantity" | How the charges are shared: quantity (base units, the default), value (each line's own cost before any landed cost), weight or volume (base quantity times the item's unit weight or volume), or amounts (given per target). |
| `date` | `--date` | string \| null | no | yes | null | When the allocation is recognised. Default: the latest charge date, never before a target receipt, and the first open date when that is later. Stock sold before it owes a forward true-up dated here. |
| `memo` | `--memo` | string \| null | no | yes | null | — |
| `number` | `--number` | string \| null | no | yes | null | Allocation number; default the next LC-n. |

## `landed-cost setup`

Make the Landed Cost Clearing account (other current asset) if it does not exist yet: charge freight and duty to it on bill, check, card charge and vendor credit expense lines, then spread it with `landed-cost post`. Example: `bookflow landed-cost setup --reason "Start tracking freight on stock"`.

A dry run previews the proposed result without saving it. Any proposed record IDs or posted status in that preview describe the prospective save, not an existing saved record.

| `E_FS_UNKNOWN` | The filesystem type of the path could not be determined. |
| `E_GUARD_REFUSED` | Bookflow's own safety check in the database refused this write, so nothing was saved. This is a Bookflow bug, not a problem with your input or your disk: please report it with this error's details and request id. |
| `E_INTERNAL` | Internal failure. |
| `E_IO` | A filesystem operation failed. |
| `E_MIGRATION_FAILED` | A schema migration failed; the database was backed up first and is unchanged. |
| `E_NETWORK_SHARE` | The path is on a network filesystem, which Bookflow refuses to use. |
| `E_NOT_INITIALIZED` | The data root is not initialized; run `bookflow init`. |

| `E_REASON_REQUIRED` | This write needs a reason: a short phrase naming what triggered it (--reason on the CLI, a top-level reason on MCP, the X-Bookflow-Reason header on HTTP). |
| `E_RECORD_NOT_FOUND` | No such record. |
| `E_SCHEMA_BEHIND` | The database schema is behind this version of Bookflow; run `bookflow upgrade`. |
| `E_SCHEMA_UNKNOWN` | The database schema revision is not known to this version of Bookflow; upgrade Bookflow. |
| `E_UNAUTHENTICATED` | No valid credential: log in, or send a bearer token. |
| `E_USAGE` | Invalid command syntax. |
| `E_VALIDATION` | Invalid input. |

## `landed-cost void`

Void a landed-cost allocation: reversing lines, its journal entry reversed, and the forward true-ups it owed backed out at its date. Refused when a freight credit allocated later needs it, and in a closed period. Example: `bookflow landed-cost void LC-3 --reason "Allocated to the wrong receipt"`.

A dry run previews the proposed result without saving it. Any proposed record IDs or posted status in that preview describe the prospective save, not an existing saved record.

| Contract | Value |
|---|---|
| Scope | company |
| Kind | write |
| Required role | standard |
| Capability | ledger.post |
| Feature | — |
| HTTP | `POST /companies/{company_id}/commands/landed-cost.void` |
| External binary body | none |

### CLI

`bookflow landed-cost void DEMO-LC-1 --company "Demo Plumbing Co" --reason "Allocated to the wrong receipt" --dry-run --json`

### MCP

The same example as complete `bookflow_run` arguments:

```json
{"command": "landed-cost void", "input": {"allocation": "DEMO-LC-1"}, "company": "Company ID or name", "dry_run": true, "reason": "Preview the requested change"}
```

### Input

| JSON field | CLI input | Type | Required | Nullable | Default | Description and constraints |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `allocation` | `ALLOCATION` | string | yes | no | — | Allocation number (LC-n) or id.; minimum length 1; maximum length 1004 |

### Command and context options

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--json` | Print one JSON object. |
| `--data-root TEXT` | Data root; otherwise `BOOKFLOW_DATA_ROOT`, then `~/.bookflow`. |
| `--dry-run` | Validate and preview without writing. |
| `--reason TEXT` | Short reason for the write. |
| `--source-ref TEXT` | Identifier of the source that triggered the write. |
| `--interactive` | Prompt for input fields not supplied as arguments or options. |
| `--directive TEXT` | Standing-instruction code or id cited by the write. |
| `--idempotency-key TEXT` | Retry-safe key for this create command. |
| `--company TEXT` | Company id, `Organization/Company`, or display name. |

### HTTP

Route: `POST /companies/{company_id}/commands/landed-cost.void`

Send the input object as JSON. Authentication may instead come from a browser session cookie.

| Header | Requirement | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `Authorization` | required for bearer clients | `Bearer <secret>` |
| `X-Bookflow-Client-Name` | optional | Stable caller name recorded in audit |
| `X-Bookflow-Client-Version` | optional | Caller version recorded in audit |
| `X-Bookflow-Context-Encoding` | optional | percent-utf8: encode all reason, source-ref, directive, idempotency-key, client-name and client-version header values as UTF-8 percent encoding |
| `X-Bookflow-Company` | optional | If sent, must equal the company ULID in the route |
| `X-Bookflow-Reason` | conditional | Short reason; an agent or system write needs this or an active directive |
| `X-Bookflow-Source-Ref` | optional | Identifier of the source that triggered the write |
| `X-Bookflow-Directive` | conditional | Active directive code or id; alternative to reason for an agent or system write |
| `Idempotency-Key` | optional | Retry-safe key for this create command |

### Errors

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `E_COMPANY_AMBIGUOUS` | More than one company matches; use the id or Organization/Company. |
| `E_COMPANY_NOT_FOUND` | No such company. |
| `E_CONFIG_INVALID` | The configuration file could not be read. |
| `E_CONTEXT_IN_INPUT` | Input contains a context field. |
| `E_DB_BUSY` | Another Bookflow command is running on this data root. |
| `E_DIRECTIVE_INACTIVE` | That directive has been deactivated. |
| `E_DIRECTIVE_NOT_FOUND` | No such directive. |
| `E_DUPLICATE_NUMBER` | That document number is already used in this document's number series. |
| `E_FEATURE_DISABLED` | This feature is not enabled for the company. |
| `E_FS_UNKNOWN` | The filesystem type of the path could not be determined. |
| `E_GUARD_REFUSED` | Bookflow's own safety check in the database refused this write, so nothing was saved. This is a Bookflow bug, not a problem with your input or your disk: please report it with this error's details and request id. |
| `E_IDEMPOTENCY_MISMATCH` | That idempotency key was used for a different command or input. |
| `E_INACTIVE_REFERENCE` | A new or changed reference must name an active record. |
| `E_INTERNAL` | Internal failure. |
| `E_IO` | A filesystem operation failed. |
| `E_MIGRATION_FAILED` | A schema migration failed; the database was backed up first and is unchanged. |
| `E_NETWORK_SHARE` | The path is on a network filesystem, which Bookflow refuses to use. |
| `E_NOT_INITIALIZED` | The data root is not initialized; run `bookflow init`. |
| `E_NO_ACTOR` | This login is not mapped to a Bookflow user. |
| `E_ORGANIZATION_NOT_FOUND` | No such organization. |
| `E_PARTIAL_WRITE` | The authoritative write committed, but a secondary update remains incomplete. |
| `E_PERIOD_CLOSED` | An affected accounting date is in a closed period. |
| `E_PERMISSION` | The acting user may not run this command here. |
| `E_REASON_REQUIRED` | This write needs a reason: a short phrase naming what triggered it (--reason on the CLI, a top-level reason on MCP, the X-Bookflow-Reason header on HTTP). |
| `E_RECORD_NOT_FOUND` | No such record. |
| `E_SCHEMA_BEHIND` | The database schema is behind this version of Bookflow; run `bookflow upgrade`. |
| `E_SCHEMA_UNKNOWN` | The database schema revision is not known to this version of Bookflow; upgrade Bookflow. |
| `E_UNAUTHENTICATED` | No valid credential: log in, or send a bearer token. |
| `E_USAGE` | Invalid command syntax. |
| `E_VALIDATION` | Invalid input. |
| `E_VALUE_RANGE` | The value is outside its allowed range or storage bounds. |
| `E_WORK_DEPENDENCY` | The accepted or linked work prevents this change; inspect the related document. |
